{
 "path": "/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-openclawlearner-1790687902/attempts/7fdda7e58310495d82461b54840148e2/system/state/workspace/programs/task-5b95e34f.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The uniquely colored object is the stencil. Background is the most frequent
    # nonzero color; zero-valued positions in its stencil footprint are wildcards.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts = {(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0,bg)}
    if not pts: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    color = grid[next(iter(pts))[0]][next(iter(pts))[1]]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts}
    mh=max(r for r,c in shape)+1; mw=max(c for r,c in shape)+1
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-mh+1):
        for c in range(w-mw+1):
            positions=[(r+dr,c+dc) for dr,dc in shape]
            if all(grid[y][x]==0 for y,x in positions):
                for y,x in positions: out[y][x]=color
    return out
"
}
